#!/usr/bin/env python3 # SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only """Make the X0X site for GitHub Pages (https://gobbajogger.github.io/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro/): index.html landing: install, breaks, projects, manual, source install/index.html web installer with version + model pickers (Web MIDI) breaks/index.html sample importer for break loops projects/index.html project save/load/reset and portable files (JS modules beside it) manual/, new/ from docs/MANUAL.md and docs/NEW.md firmware/*.fwsc packages for every published version/model kept on the site versions.json catalog the installer loads (also inlined into install/) Legacy (single package): tools/make_pages.py build/x0x-0.1-beta.fwsc 0.1-beta OUT_DIR Multi-model SMK release (keeps older versions when --merge points at an existing site): tools/make_pages.py --version 0.2 --out OUT_DIR \\ --pro build/x0x-smk37-0.2.fwsc \\ --elite build/x0x-smk37-elite-0.2.fwsc \\ --mke build/x0x-smk37-mke-0.2.fwsc \\ [--merge EXISTING_SITE] Hostable shell (no packages yet; drop-.fwsc + Releases API still work): tools/make_pages.py --shell --out OUT_DIR [--merge EXISTING_SITE] """ from __future__ import annotations import argparse import hashlib import html import json import re import shutil import subprocess import sys from pathlib import Path SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] sys.path.insert(0, str(SRC / "web")) from make_site import product_of, strip_module # noqa: E402 REPO = "https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro" PAGES = "https://gobbajogger.github.io/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro" MODEL_FILE = { "pro": "x0x37-{ver}.fwsc", "elite": "x0x37-{ver}-elite.fwsc", "mke": "x0x37-{ver}-mke.fwsc", "fm1": "x0x-{ver}.fwsc", } def installer_model(product: str) -> str: """Return the exact supported target model for a release package identity.""" if re.fullmatch(r"FM-1_9(?:\d{2}|\d{6})", product) and product != "FM-1_900": return "FM-1" m = re.fullmatch(r"(SMK-37 Pro|SMK-37 Elite|MKE-P37)_9\d{6}", product) if m: return m.group(1) raise SystemExit(f"unsupported installer identity {product!r}: use a release build for FM-1 or SMK-37") def model_key(product: str) -> str: name = installer_model(product) return {"FM-1": "fm1", "SMK-37 Pro": "pro", "SMK-37 Elite": "elite", "MKE-P37": "mke"}[name] def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with path.open("rb") as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""): h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest() def safe_version(version: str) -> str: return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9.-]", "-", version) def pkg_entry(path: Path, version: str, key: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, dict]: raw = path.read_bytes() product = product_of(raw) try: installer_model(product) except SystemExit as e: raise SystemExit(f"{path}: identity {product!r}: make a release build") from e if b"FELUCCA-LOADER-1" not in raw: raise SystemExit(f"{path}: no update loader in it") key = key or model_key(product) name = MODEL_FILE[key].format(ver=safe_version(version)) return key, { "product": product, "pkg": f"../firmware/{name}", "file": name, "sha256": sha256_file(path), "size": len(raw), "src": path, } LANDING = """ X0X for the SMK-37 · Loopy Pro

X0X

Groovebox firmware for the M-VAVE SMK-37 (Pro, Elite, MKE-P37) and the FM-1. A 909, an 808, two 303s with TB-3PO, and a breakbeat player — with an APC40-style clip launcher for Loopy Pro on the SMK-37.

Install any published version from Chrome or Edge over USB. The sample importer puts your own loops into the BREAK slots (optional oldschool grit, with preview before you write). Installing is at your own risk; packages keep the keyboard's model name so M-UPGRADE still works.
Install__VERSION_LABEL__ What's new?Upgrade, downgrade, or switch: pick a published version and model, or drop any .fwsc (stock / other custom). Nothing to install on the computer.
Sample importerDrop in loops and send them to the BREAK part. Off by default: optional oldschool grit (light to max) and listen-before-send preview. Chrome or Edge. ProjectsSave, load and reset on the keyboard, or export a project with its original samples. ManualGetting started, then everything else — including the SMK-37 map. All releasesFirmware files for the command line: python3 tools/fm1_install.py … SourceGitHub, GPL-3.0. Built on Felucca by Hügelton Instruments.

SMK-37 control map: see SMK37.md. To go back to the official firmware, use M-VAVE's M-UPGRADE from m-vave.com/download, or drop the stock .fwsc on the install page. M-VAVE, FM-1 and SMK-37 are trademarks of their owners. Loopy Pro is a product of A Tasty Pixel.

""" def load_catalog(path: Path | None) -> dict: if not path or not path.is_file(): return {"repo": REPO, "pages": PAGES, "latest": None, "versions": []} data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) data.setdefault("repo", REPO) data.setdefault("pages", PAGES) data.setdefault("versions", []) return data def merge_version(catalog: dict, version: str, models: dict) -> dict: """Insert or replace one version entry; keep other versions' packages.""" versions = [v for v in catalog.get("versions", []) if v.get("version") != version] entry = {"version": version, "models": {}} for key, meta in models.items(): entry["models"][key] = { "product": meta["product"], "pkg": f"../firmware/{meta['file']}" if not str(meta["pkg"]).startswith("http") else meta["pkg"], "sha256": meta["sha256"], "size": meta["size"], } versions.append(entry) versions.sort(key=lambda v: str(v["version"]), reverse=True) catalog = dict(catalog) catalog["versions"] = versions catalog["latest"] = version catalog["repo"] = REPO catalog["pages"] = PAGES return catalog def write_site(out: Path, catalog: dict, copy_pkgs: dict[str, Path], merge_from: Path | None, banner=None): """Build OUT from catalog; copy_pkgs maps firmware filename -> source path for this publish.""" if out.exists(): shutil.rmtree(out) for d in ("install", "manual", "firmware", "breaks", "projects", "new"): (out / d).mkdir(parents=True) # Carry forward every firmware file still referenced, plus new packages. keep = {m["pkg"].split("/")[-1] for v in catalog["versions"] for m in v.get("models", {}).values() if not str(m.get("pkg", "")).startswith("http")} if merge_from: src_fw = merge_from / "firmware" if src_fw.is_dir(): for f in src_fw.glob("*.fwsc"): if f.name in keep: shutil.copy2(f, out / "firmware" / f.name) for name, src in copy_pkgs.items(): shutil.copy2(src, out / "firmware" / name) # Installer: inline libraries + catalog (paths relative to install/) page = (SRC / "web" / "x0x_installer.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8") lib = "\n".join(strip_module((SRC / "web" / f).read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for f in ("fm1pkg.js", "fm1ota.js", "x0x_breaks.js", "factory_break_pack.js", "boot_screen.js")) cat_json = json.dumps(catalog, separators=(",", ":")) for mark, repl in (("/*LIB*/", lib), ("/*CATALOG*/", cat_json)): if page.count(mark) != 1: raise SystemExit(f"x0x_installer.html must contain {mark} once") page = page.replace(mark, repl) (out / "install" / "index.html").write_text(page, encoding="utf-8") # Browser-relative catalog (install page also embeds it) browser_cat = json.loads(cat_json) for v in browser_cat["versions"]: for m in v.get("models", {}).values(): if m["pkg"].startswith("../firmware/"): m["pkg"] = m["pkg"].replace("../firmware/", "firmware/", 1) (out / "versions.json").write_text(json.dumps(browser_cat, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8") # Breaks (sample importer) breaks = (SRC / "web" / "x0x_breaks.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8") breaks = breaks.replace("https://github.com/charlesvestal/fm1-x0x", REPO) if breaks.count("/*LIB*/") != 1: raise SystemExit("x0x_breaks.html must contain /*LIB*/ once") lib = strip_module((SRC / "web" / "x0x_breaks.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8")) (out / "breaks" / "index.html").write_text(breaks.replace("/*LIB*/", lib), encoding="utf-8") # The project page keeps its testable modules intact; it also runs from web/ on localhost. shutil.copy(SRC / "web" / "x0x_projects.html", out / "projects" / "index.html") for module in ("x0x_projects.js", "x0x_breaks.js"): shutil.copy(SRC / "web" / module, out / "projects" / module) subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SRC / "tools" / "manual_html.py"), str(SRC / "docs" / "MANUAL.md"), str(out / "manual" / "index.html")], check=True, capture_output=True) shutil.copy(SRC / "docs" / "PROJECT_FILES.md", out / "manual" / "PROJECT_FILES.md") shutil.copytree(SRC / "docs" / "img", out / "manual" / "img") subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SRC / "tools" / "manual_html.py"), str(SRC / "docs" / "NEW.md"), str(out / "new" / "index.html")], check=True, capture_output=True) if (SRC / "docs" / "img" / "new").is_dir(): shutil.copytree(SRC / "docs" / "img" / "new", out / "new" / "img" / "new") latest = catalog.get("latest") or (catalog["versions"][0]["version"] if catalog["versions"] else "") ver_label = f" v{html.escape(str(latest))}" if latest else "" landing = (LANDING.replace("__VERSION_LABEL__", ver_label) .replace("__REPO__", REPO)) if banner: landing = landing.replace("
", "
" + html.escape(banner) + " ", 1) (out / "index.html").write_text(landing, encoding="utf-8") (out / ".nojekyll").write_text("") models = ", ".join(sorted({k for v in catalog["versions"] for k in v.get("models", {})})) print(f"site: {out}: {len(catalog['versions'])} version(s), models [{models}], " f"firmware files {len(list((out / 'firmware').glob('*.fwsc')))}") def main_legacy(pkg: Path, version: str, out: Path, merge: Path | None): key, meta = pkg_entry(pkg, version) catalog = load_catalog((merge / "versions.json") if merge else None) catalog = merge_version(catalog, version, {key: meta}) write_site(out, catalog, {meta["file"]: meta["src"]}, merge) def main_shell(out: Path, merge: Path | None): """Hostable site with installer + sample importer; catalog may be empty until a release.""" catalog = load_catalog((merge / "versions.json") if merge else None) catalog["repo"] = REPO catalog["pages"] = PAGES write_site(out, catalog, {}, merge) def main_multi(args): version = args.version models = {} for key, path in (("pro", args.pro), ("elite", args.elite), ("mke", args.mke), ("fm1", args.fm1)): if not path: continue k, meta = pkg_entry(Path(path), version, key) if k != key: raise SystemExit(f"{path}: identity is {meta['product']} (expected model {key})") models[key] = meta if not models: raise SystemExit("pass at least one of --pro / --elite / --mke / --fm1") merge = Path(args.merge) if args.merge else None catalog = load_catalog((merge / "versions.json") if merge else None) catalog = merge_version(catalog, version, models) write_site(Path(args.out), catalog, {m["file"]: m["src"] for m in models.values()}, merge) def main(argv=None): argv = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv) if argv and not argv[0].startswith("-") and len(argv) == 3: main_legacy(Path(argv[0]), argv[1], Path(argv[2]), None) return ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter) ap.add_argument("--shell", action="store_true", help="build hostable site without new packages (drop-.fwsc + Releases still work)") ap.add_argument("--version", help="release version label, e.g. 0.2 or 1.0.6") ap.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="output site directory") ap.add_argument("--pro", help="SMK-37 Pro .fwsc") ap.add_argument("--elite", help="SMK-37 Elite .fwsc") ap.add_argument("--mke", help="MKE-P37 .fwsc") ap.add_argument("--fm1", help="FM-1 .fwsc") ap.add_argument("--merge", help="existing site dir whose firmware/ and versions.json to keep") args = ap.parse_args(argv) merge = Path(args.merge) if args.merge else None if args.shell: main_shell(Path(args.out), merge) return if not args.version: raise SystemExit("--version is required unless --shell") main_multi(args) if __name__ == "__main__": try: main() except BrokenPipeError: pass

#!/bin/sh
# Clip mode knobs (owner report 2026-10-17 02:49 on c6bf44a: in clip mode the knobs do nothing).
# Runs the REAL clip keybed code of main_fm1.c (smk_ck_poll, ck_controls: knobs 2-8 send CC 48-54), the
# REAL clip feedback code (apc_out, the CLP-18 link code) and the REAL usb.c (usb_poll, ep1_tx), and
# checks the CC that goes to the host on USB (EP1 IN) and on Bluetooth (ble_out).
# K1-K8 pass on f9bcc46 and on each commit up to c6bf44a (bisect 2026-10-17 03:00).
# K9: knobs 2-5 set SCALE, CHORD or ARP (CLP-62, CLP-63). K9 fails from e8b2c7f up to aa7f666.
# K10: only the stage state gives the knobs (not a page, a pad or Loopy), the keybed notes change, knobs 6-8
# keep no turns. K10 fails on 54f92b2 (5 fail).
# SRC=<dir> runs it on the firmware sources of another commit (the bisect), default firmware/src.
# --extract-only prepares the shared harness without compiling or running the knob probe.
set -e
EXTRACT_ONLY=0
case "$#:$*" in
    0:) ;;
    1:--extract-only) EXTRACT_ONLY=1 ;;
    *) echo "usage: $0 [--extract-only]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
SRC=${SRC:-firmware/src}
OUT=${OUT:-build/host/clip_knob}
mkdir -p $OUT/src $OUT/hal
cp $SRC/usb.c $OUT/src/usb.c
cp tests/host/smk_clip_knob_fake_usb.h $OUT/hal/fm1_usb.h
M=$SRC/app/main_fm1.c
awk '/^static volatile uint8_t clip_grid_mode;/{on=1} /^#include "app\/smk_clip_keys.h"/{on=0} on' $M > $OUT/apc_a.inc
awk '/^\/\* Loopy Undo \/ Redo/{on=0} /^static uint8_t knob_bank_prev;/{on=1} on' $M > $OUT/apc_b.inc
awk '/^\/\* -+ clip mode keybed/{on=1} /^\/\* ------- clip mode screen/{on=0} on' $M > $OUT/ck_a.inc
awk '/^CK_FN void smk_ck_poll\(void\)/{on=1} on; on && /^}/{exit}' $M > $OUT/ck_b.inc
awk '/^#define AUTOSAVE_QUIET/{print} /^\/\* AUTOSAVE:/{on=1} /^void ui_frame\(void\)/{on=0} on' $SRC/app/ui.c > $OUT/autosave.inc
awk '/^#define PADLED_N 16u/{on=1} on && /^#endif/{exit} on' $SRC/lcd.c > $OUT/padled.inc
for f in apc_a apc_b ck_a ck_b autosave padled; do
    test -s $OUT/$f.inc || { echo "FAIL: marker for $f.inc not found"; exit 1; }
done
[ "$EXTRACT_ONLY" = 0 ] || exit 0
# CK_RATE_T / ck_arp_pick live in smk_clip_arp_share.c (size share); same link as smk-clip-keys.
${CC:-cc} -std=gnu99 -O1 -w -I$SRC -Ifirmware/hal -I$OUT -o $OUT/smk_clip_knob_test \
  tests/host/smk_clip_knob_test.c firmware/src/app/smk_clip_arp_share.c
$OUT/smk_clip_knob_test

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# tools/require_gate_pass.sh (the install guard) with a temp index.md and a temp results folder
# (X0X_RESULTS_DIR). Each refusal case must print "REFUSED" with exit code 3; the gate PASS case
# must print "GATE OK" with exit code 0. A real result (9a733fe, tree 1d3c048d...) is also checked
# when /workspace/x0x37.git and /workspace/x0x37-results are on this computer.
set -u
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_PREFIX GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH GIT_NAMESPACE   # a hook sets these; a scratch repository must not use the repository of the hook
unset X0X_GATE_LOGS_MAP X0X_SYNC_DIR
G="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)/tools/require_gate_pass.sh"
T=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/igg.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
# commit.md rule 9 (tests use temp files): the queue file of every case is a temp file (empty: no open lines).
# The live QUEUE.md never reaches this test. tests/host/test_queue_guard.sh tests the queue.
X0X_QUEUE_FILE=$(mktemp "$T/queue.XXXXXX"); export X0X_QUEUE_FILE
fails=0; n=0
expect() {  # expect <REFUSED|GATE OK> <name> <args...>
    want=$1; name=$2; shift 2; n=$((n + 1))
    out=$(X0X_RESULTS_DIR="$T/res" X0X_REPO="$T/repo" bash "$G" "$@" 2>&1); rc=$?
    case "$want" in REFUSED) wrc=3;; *) wrc=0;; esac
    case "$out" in "$want "*) [ "$rc" = "$wrc" ] && { echo "ok   $name: $out"; return; };; esac
    echo "FAIL $name: rc=$rc out=$out"; fails=$((fails + 1))
}
# a temp repository and its gate tree key (the same command as tools/gate.sh)
mkdir -p "$T/repo" "$T/res" && cd "$T/repo" && git init -q . && echo a > a.c && echo doc > README.md && \
    git add . && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -qm one && cd - >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL setup"; exit 1; }
H=$(git -C "$T/repo" rev-parse HEAD); S=$(echo "$H" | cut -c1-7)
if command -v sha1sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then SHA1=sha1sum; else SHA1="shasum -a 1"; fi
TREE=$(git -C "$T/repo" ls-tree -r --full-tree "$H" | awk -F '\t' '$2 !~ /\.md$/' | $SHA1 | cut -c1-40)
T12=$(echo "$TREE" | cut -c1-12); OTHER=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
printf 'fwsc bytes\n' > "$T/good.fwsc"; printf 'ctl bytes\n' > "$T/ctl.img"; printf 'other\n' > "$T/bad.fwsc"
crc() { python3 -c 'import sys, zlib; print("%08x" % (zlib.crc32(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()) & 0xffffffff))' "$1"; }
FC=$(crc "$T/good.fwsc"); CC=$(crc "$T/ctl.img")
L="$T/work/$S.logs"; mkdir -p "$L"
printf 'gate: took the gate lock after 0 s\ngate: released the gate lock; the tests took 1 s\n' > "$L/gate.log"
printf 'ctl.img file crc32 %s, 10 B\nbuild/x0x-smk37-elite.fwsc crc32 %s, 11 B\n' "$CC" "$FC" > "$L/crc.txt"
INPUT_ID=$(python3 - "$G" "$T/repo" "$L" <<'PYID'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(sys.argv[1]).parent))
import validation_inputs as v
# Synthetic provenance only; no validation run or device involved.
payload = {'schema': v.SCHEMA, 'mode': 'gate', 'source': v.source_tree(sys.argv[2], 'HEAD')}
data = {'schema': v.SCHEMA, 'inputs': payload, 'sha256': v.digest(v.encoded(payload))}
(Path(sys.argv[3])/'validation-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(data))
print(data['sha256'])
PYID
)
result() {  # result <file> <Result line> <tree>
    { echo "# Gate result for tree $3"; echo; echo "$2"; echo; echo "- Commit: $H"
      echo "- Validation inputs: $INPUT_ID"
      echo "- Tree (SHA-1 of git ls-tree -r without *.md): $3"; echo "- Worktree: $T/work/$S. Logs: $L."
      echo; echo "## CRC manifest"; echo; echo '```'; cat "$L/crc.txt"; echo '```'; } > "$T/res/$1"; }
index() { printf '| Commit | Tree | Git tree | Result | Result file | Time |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n' > "$T/res/index.md"
          for r in "$@"; do echo "$r" >> "$T/res/index.md"; done; }
row() { echo "| $S | $T12 | 000000000000 | $1 | $2 | 2026-10-16 22:00 +10 |"; }

index; expect REFUSED "no row" "$H"
index "$(row 'PASS' "$TREE.md")"; expect REFUSED "manual row, no result file" "$H"
result "$TREE.md" "Result: PASS" "$TREE"
index "$(row 'PASS (backfill)' "$TREE.md")"; expect REFUSED "hand-written PASS text" "$H"
result "$TREE.trial-1.md" "Result: TRIAL PASS (a trial run with --trial: not a release PASS)" "$TREE"
index "$(row 'TRIAL PASS' "$TREE.trial-1.md")"; expect REFUSED "TRIAL PASS" "$H"
index "$(row 'VOID (setup error: no toolchain; not a test result)' "$TREE.md")"; expect REFUSED "VOID" "$H"
index "$(row 'FAIL' "$TREE.md")" "$(row 'KILLED' "$TREE.md")"; expect REFUSED "FAIL and KILLED" "$H"
result "$OTHER.md" "Result: PASS" "$OTHER"
index "$(row 'PASS' "$OTHER.md")"; expect REFUSED "PASS row, result file of another tree" "$H"
index "$(row 'PASS' "$TREE.md")"
mv "$L/gate.log" "$L/gate.keep"; printf 'build output only\n' > "$L/gate.log"
expect REFUSED "gate.log without gate lines" "$H"; mv "$L/gate.keep" "$L/gate.log"
expect REFUSED "CRC mismatch" "$H" --fwsc "$T/bad.fwsc" --ctl "$T/ctl.img"
expect "GATE OK" "gate PASS" "$H" --fwsc "$T/good.fwsc" --ctl "$T/ctl.img"
index "$(row 'PASS' "$TREE.md")" "$(row 'PASS (result used again)' "$TREE.md")"; expect "GATE OK" "PASS (result used again)" "$H"
# tools/sync_results_to_mac.sh: pack on the box, unpack on the "Mac" (a temp folder), then the guard
# uses only the copy (the original logs folder is moved away). All copied files must be read-only.
SY="$(dirname "$G")/sync_results_to_mac.sh"; n=$((n + 1))
p=$(X0X_RESULTS_DIR="$T/res" X0X_SYNC_DIR="$T/sync" bash "$SY" --pack 2>&1) && \
    u=$(X0X_RESULTS_DIR="$T/mac" bash "$SY" --unpack "$T/sync/latest.tar" 2>&1) && mv "$L" "$L.away" && \
    out=$(X0X_RESULTS_DIR="$T/mac" X0X_REPO="$T/repo" bash "$G" "$H" --fwsc "$T/good.fwsc" --ctl "$T/ctl.img" 2>&1); rc=$?
mv "$L.away" "$L" 2>/dev/null
rw=$(find "$T/mac" -type f -perm -u+w ! -path '*/.unpack.*' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
case "$out" in "GATE OK $S $T/mac/"*) if [ "$rc" = 0 ] && [ "$rw" = 0 ]; then echo "ok   sync pack + unpack, guard on the copy: $out"
    else echo "FAIL sync: rc=$rc writable=$rw $out"; fails=$((fails + 1)); fi ;;
*) echo "FAIL sync: rc=$rc $p $u $out"; fails=$((fails + 1)) ;; esac
chmod -R u+w "$T/mac" 2>/dev/null
# fm1_install.py: a real install with no --commit stops before it opens a device (exit 9)
n=$((n + 1)); out=$(python3 "$(dirname "$G")/fm1_install.py" "$T/good.fwsc" 2>&1); rc=$?
if [ "$rc" = 9 ] && echo "$out" | grep -q REFUSED; then echo "ok   fm1_install.py without --commit: exit 9"; else echo "FAIL fm1_install.py without --commit: rc=$rc $out"; fails=$((fails + 1)); fi
# two configs (dev X0X_DEV_PADCAL=1, rel 0): the CRC must be in the lines of the config that --config names.
# A result with one config (above) counts only as dev. The index row has the Configs column.
printf 'release bytes\n' > "$T/rel.fwsc"; RC=$(crc "$T/rel.fwsc")
printf 'ctl.img file crc32 %s, 10 B\nbuild/x0x-smk37-elite.fwsc crc32 %s, 11 B\nrel/build/x0x-smk37-elite.fwsc crc32 %s, 14 B\n' "$CC" "$FC" "$RC" > "$L/crc.txt"
result "$TREE-2.md" "Result: PASS" "$TREE"
awk -v c="- Config CRCs: dev elite $FC, ble -; rel elite $RC, ble -" '/^- Worktree: /{print c} {print}' "$T/res/$TREE-2.md" > "$T/r2" && mv "$T/r2" "$T/res/$TREE-2.md"
index "| $S | $T12 | 000000000000 | PASS | $TREE-2.md | 2026-10-17 00:30 +10 | dev elite $FC; rel elite $RC |"
expect "GATE OK" "two configs: dev fwsc, --config dev" "$H" --fwsc "$T/good.fwsc" --config dev --ctl "$T/ctl.img"
expect "GATE OK" "two configs: dev fwsc, no --config (dev)" "$H" --fwsc "$T/good.fwsc"
expect "GATE OK" "two configs: rel fwsc, --config rel" "$H" --fwsc "$T/rel.fwsc" --config rel
expect REFUSED "two configs: rel fwsc, --config dev (swapped)" "$H" --fwsc "$T/rel.fwsc" --config dev
expect REFUSED "two configs: dev fwsc, --config rel (swapped)" "$H" --fwsc "$T/good.fwsc" --config rel
expect REFUSED "two configs: unknown CRC, --config rel" "$H" --fwsc "$T/bad.fwsc" --config rel
index "$(row 'PASS' "$TREE.md")"
